request.initial_prompt: That movement from the Nízhni to the Ryazán, Túla, and Kalúga roads was so natural that even the Russian marauders moved in that direction, and demands were sent from Petersburg for Kutúzov to take his army that way. At Tarútino Kutúzov received what was almost a reprimand from the Emperor for having moved his army along the Ryazán road, and the Emperor's letter indicated to him the very position he had already occupied near Kalúga.

raw_segments.text: That movement from the Nízhni to the Ryazán, Túla, and Kalúga roads was so natural that even
the Russian marauders moved in that direction, and demands were sent from Petersburg for Kutúzov
to take his army that way. At Tarútino Kutúzov received what was almost a reprimand from the
Emperor for having moved his army along the Ryazán road, and the Emperor's letter indicated to him
the very position he had already occupied near Kalúga.
